notes: 1.0.36: The app now tells you when it cannot pick a device. If two Tip Chargers are plugged in, or the auto-reconnect keeps failing, you get a clear message instead of the app silently not connecting. This build also carries the 1.0.35 changes that were never released: supplier and model names removed from the screens (plain descriptive labels instead), the servo drive shown as a direct RS485 connection with its own diagnostics panel (the RS232-to-Ethernet bridge option is gone), and a leftover screen-select box that did nothing has been removed.
